Ceasefire in Gaza at Risk of Collapse, Board of Peace Warns

The US-backed Board of Peace has issued a bleak report warning that the ceasefire in Gaza is at risk of imminent collapse unless immediate action is taken. The board cautioned the UN that the current situation could lead to the breakdown of the fragile peace.
